profile_text.body:
Confident AI is a software company whose primary public presence is its GitHub repository. The site's harvested text reflects GitHub's own platform description rather than Confident AI's corporate website, so direct information from the company's own web presence is limited.

The company's tracked product is DeepEval, an open-source LLM evaluation framework built on pytest. DeepEval supports assertion-based continuous integration gating, a G-Eval scoring method, multi-turn conversational test cases, and a red-teaming companion library. It is categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform and is hosted at github.com/confident-ai/deepeval.
